title: Project: Goliath
description: Many bosses and adventures with magic, iron's spells, create, create: aeronautics and L_Enders_Cataclysm. This modpack was made for a server I'm starting by the same name.
body:
# Project: Goliath

Goliath is a modpack primarily focused on boss fights, looting, and adventuring. With some of my favorite mods peppered in, i.e. Create.
May all who use this pack adventure well, whether it's in single player or with friends. (You can use [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential) if you don't wanna pay for a server.)

## Features:
#### (As of current release)

- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and its addons (including [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics))
- [Simply swords](https://modrinth.com/mod/simply-swords) (adds many swords some with unique abilities)
- [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat) (adds physical weapon swinging)
- [Mowzie's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/mowzies-mobs) (adds mobs and bosses)
- [Bosses'Rise](https://modrinth.com/mod/bossesrise) (also adds bosses)
- [L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm) (also adds bosses)
- [Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooks) (magic/spell system)
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and its addons (Adds soo many food options)
- [Enchiridion](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchiridion) (enchanting overhaul)
- [Xaero Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) (map mods)
- [Xaero Worldmap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) (map mods)
- [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones) (with xaero map support)
- [Jewelry (RPG Series)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jewelry) (craftable jewelery that provide buffs)
- [Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks:Monsters & Spellbooks](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooksmonsters-spellbooks/versions) (Adds way more spells & mobs that can use spells)
- [Create: Wizardry](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-wizardry) (adds compatability between create and Iron's Spells for recipes)
- [Acedium Sodiumized](https://modrinth.com/mod/acedium-sodiumized) (basically nvidium)
  (this may make your game run better if you have a nvidia gpu)
- [Sophisticated Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage) (A storage mod that adds different levels of chests with more storage, etc.)
- [Tom's simple storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage) 
(adds a unified Gui for viewing/crafting with all items in a [Sophisticated Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage) network)
- [Nature's Compass](https://modrinth.com/mod/natures-compass) (allows the easy location of biomes)
- [Immersive Melodies](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-melodies) (adds instraments for all you bardic needs; mobs can also spawn with them.)
- Controller support (Untested*)
- Qol mods: appleskin, Jei, ETC.
- And More. (I probably forgot to list a few)
